principles: Reject wrong self-host runtime before handler dispatch
Make authority mechanically observable and testable
drivers: Prevent minutes of invalid validation work
Avoid evidence produced by code other than the story worktree code
Reuse existing runtime-fact classification and doctor contract

options.name: A: pre-dispatch self-host runtime authority guard
pros: Stops expensive and mutating work before dispatch
Can reuse root, entrypoint and runtime realpath facts
cons: Must handle symlink and worktree paths carefully

options.name: B: doctor warning only
cons: Does not stop stale mutation or validation
Operators can miss the warning until after wasted work

options.name: C: ban global lattice everywhere in worktrees
cons: Breaks explicit heartbeat fallback and some external-development launchers
Conflates missing local build with wrong runtime

chosen: A: pre-dispatch self-host runtime authority guard
rationale: Only option A prevents the observed B-914f waste before handler execution while preserving external consumers and using the runtime facts already maintained by doctor.

preMortem.scenario: A symlinked worktree-local launcher is mistaken for the main global runtime
preMortem.trigger: Comparison uses lexical paths instead of canonical realpaths and worktree/common-dir identity
preMortem.mitigation: Canonicalize entrypoint/core roots and test symlinked local launchers in hermetic main-plus-worktree fixtures.

preMortem.scenario: The guard blocks external projects that correctly consume global Lattice
preMortem.trigger: Self-project detection treats any repository with lattice.config.json as Proofbound source
preMortem.mitigation: Require canonical self-source markers plus git worktree/common-dir relationship; external scope remains warn/advisory.

preMortem.scenario: A stale runtime reaches mutation through an exempt command alias
preMortem.trigger: Exemption is name-based and nested aliases bypass normalization
preMortem.mitigation: Normalize aliases first and permit only explicit heartbeat marker plus read-only command policy; assert handler invocation count stays zero for all mutating aliases.

preMortem.scenario: The diagnostic points to a local entrypoint whose dist is missing
preMortem.trigger: Recovery always prints node bin/lattice.js without bootstrap readiness context
preMortem.consequence: User hits a second opaque failure
preMortem.mitigation: Preserve bootstrap-runner missing-artifact diagnosis; authority guard recovery names local entrypoint and bootstrap supplies build steps when needed.
